# Grid Cells

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Rows with a grid cell id (H3, S2, A5, geohash or quadkey) as polygon features of their cells, keeping their columns; a column of H3 id lists draws each list’s merged outline. What deck’s cell layers draw. Runs in the engine.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "cells", "name": "cells", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |

| `kind` | `menu` | `"h3"` | `h3`, `h3-cluster`, `s2`, `a5`, `geohash`, `quadkey` |
| `column` | `column` | `"hex"` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->
